name: TeliportMe
positioning: Browser-based 3D virtual tour editor built to distribute tours across every listing platform, not just its own player.
description: TeliportMe is a browser-based editor for creating 360° virtual tours — hotspots, nadir/zenith patches, background audio, interactive cards and floor plans — without installing software, and for distributing the finished tour by link, iframe embed, or directly onto third-party listing sites.
real_estate_use: An agent, broker or photography vendor captures 360° panoramas of a property, edits them into a guided tour in the browser, and embeds or links the tour directly on the listing across sites such as Zillow, Realtor.com or Compass — used specifically because the tour is meant to travel with the listing across platforms rather than live only on one branded page.
features: Browser-based tour editor with GPU rendering
Embed on third-party listing platforms (Zillow, Realtor.com, Compass)

use_cases.job: Publish a 360° tour that embeds directly on major listing portals rather than a standalone branded page
